scenarios.name: kv-tiering-prefix-online
scenarios.title: Official KV tiering prefix online serving benchmark
scenarios.description: Prefix repetition workload for KV tiering pressure on a single Ascend 910B2 chip.

scenarios.name: logprobs-online
scenarios.title: Official logprobs online serving benchmark
scenarios.description: Synthetic online serving workload with logprobs enabled.

scenarios.name: ngram-instructcoder-online
scenarios.title: Official ngram InstructCoder online serving benchmark
scenarios.description: InstructCoder online workload for ngram speculative decoding evaluation.

scenarios.name: attention-boundary-online
scenarios.title: Attention boundary stress online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Mixed prefill/decode workload stressing attention metadata CPU mirrors, D2H sync, and host overhead at the attention boundary. Used for vllm-hust #6/#10/#13/#30/#37/#46 performance evidence.

scenarios.name: kv-pressure-online
scenarios.title: KV cache pressure online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: High-concurrency long-context workload near KV capacity boundary. Measures preemption, eviction, throughput degradation, and tail latency. Used for vllm-hust #54/#171 and BidKV evaluation.

scenarios.name: agent-cache-pressure-online
scenarios.title: Agent cache pressure online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Multi-turn agent workload with high cache pressure and eviction-sensitive patterns. Measures cache hit rate, eviction count, SLO compliance, and throughput. Used for vllm-hust #171 BidKV victim selector and vllm-ascend-hust #39.

scenarios.name: saturated-warm-cache-online
scenarios.title: SimLLM saturated warm-cache online serving benchmark (issue #59 / #89)
scenarios.description: Saturated warm-cache throughput benchmark for SimLLM proactive scheduler/KV injection. Measures cache hit, prefill token reduction, TTFT/P99, and saturated throughput. Final spec pending issue #59; this placeholder enables registry alignment.

scenarios.name: spec-decode-online
scenarios.title: Speculative decoding online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Online serving workload with speculative decoding (EAGLE/EAGLE3). Measures acceptance rate, draft tokens, throughput, and TTFT. Used for vllm-hust #121 and vllm-ascend-hust #123.

scenarios.name: unified-comm-online
scenarios.title: Unified communication abstraction online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Communication-sensitive multi-chip online workload for unified_comm abstraction evaluation. Records topology, backend, and communication overhead. Used for vllm-hust #42. A separate component microbench is also recommended alongside this e2e workload.

scenarios.name: unified-comm-online-1chip
scenarios.title: Unified communication abstraction online serving benchmark (1-chip)
scenarios.description: Communication-sensitive single-chip online workload for unified_comm abstraction evaluation. Non-executable draft pending upstream custom comm path support (Issue #136).

scenarios.name: unified-comm-online-4chip
scenarios.title: Unified communication abstraction online serving benchmark (4-chip)
scenarios.description: Communication-sensitive four-chip single-node online workload for unified_comm abstraction evaluation. Non-executable draft pending upstream custom comm path support (Issue #136).

scenarios.name: multi-nic-throughput
scenarios.title: Multi-NIC throughput benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Multi-node throughput workload comparing single-NIC vs multi-NIC configurations. Records NIC count, topology, node/card count, bandwidth, TTFT/TBT, and throughput. Used for vllm-hust #168.

scenarios.name: eplb-expert-rebalance-online
scenarios.title: EPLB expert rebalance online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Expert parallel load balancing control-plane overhead workload. Measures update latency, step time, throughput, and tail latency during expert rebalancing. Used for vllm-ascend-hust #36.

scenarios.name: kv-transfer-latency
scenarios.title: KV transfer bandwidth and latency benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Device KV transfer prototype bandwidth/latency microbench plus online KV migration sanity. Measures transfer bandwidth, migration latency, and online serving impact. Used for issue #67.

scenarios.name: slicegpt-compression-online
scenarios.title: SliceGPT compression online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Dense vs SliceGPT compressed model serving comparison. Reports throughput, memory, and PPL/task quality. Used for vllm-hust #158. Published as model-compression specialty card.

scenarios.name: knorm-kv-compression-longctx
scenarios.title: Knorm KV compression long-context online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: Long-context workload with Knorm KV compression. Must report throughput, memory, and quality/error metrics simultaneously. Used for vllm-hust #76.

scenarios.name: moe-alltoall-online
scenarios.title: MoE all-to-all communication online serving benchmark (issue #89)
scenarios.description: MoE/communication-sensitive multi-chip workload measuring all-to-all receive-buffer reuse, allocation wait, and end-to-end throughput. Used for vllm-ascend-hust #7.
